commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: baseline"
free -h
swapon --show || true

echo "STEP: install zram kernel module package"
sudo -n DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y linux-modules-extra-4.4.0-210-generic

echo "STEP: modprobe options (1 device)"
printf 'options zram num_devices=1\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/modprobe.d/zram.conf
printf 'zram\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/modules-load.d/zram.conf

echo "STEP: load module now"
sudo -n modprobe zram
lsmod | grep zram

echo "STEP: write zram-swap systemd service"
cat <<'EOF' | sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service
[Unit]
Description=Compressed swap (zram), preferred over disk swap
After=systemd-modules-load.service local-fs.target
Before=swap.target
DefaultDependencies=no
Conflicts=shutdown.target
Before=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStartPre=/sbin/modprobe zram
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c 'echo lz4 > /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm || true'
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'echo 512M > /sys/block/zram0/disksize'
ExecStart=/sbin/mkswap /dev/zram0
ExecStart=/sbin/swapon -p 100 /dev/zram0
ExecStop=/sbin/swapoff /dev/zram0

[Install]
WantedBy=swap.target multi-user.target
EOF

echo "STEP: enable + start service"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable zram-swap.service
sudo -n systemctl start zram-swap.service
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled zram-swap.service
sudo -n systemctl is-active zram-swap.service

echo "STEP: verify swap active"
swapon --show
cat /proc/swaps
free -h
echo "== zram device info =="
cat /sys/block/zram0/disksize
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm
